Rfg Advisory Group Has Lifted Holding in Apple (AAPL); Bowling Portfolio Management Has Cut Its Holding in Bofi Holding (BOFI) by $562,049
May 21, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Bowling Portfolio Management Llc decreased its stake in Bofi Holding Inc (BOFI) by 34.38% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bowling Portfolio Management Llc sold 19,381 shares as the company’s stock rose 36.36% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 36,997 shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.11 million, down from 56,378 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bowling Portfolio Management Llc who had been investing in Bofi Holding Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $2.62B market cap company. The stock increased 0.34% or $0.14 during the last trading session, reaching $41.83. About 124,633 shares traded. BofI Holding, Inc. (NASDAQ:BOFI) has risen 42.81% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 31.26% the S&P500.
Rfg Advisory Group Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 29.94% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rfg Advisory Group Llc bought 4,437 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 19,258 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.33M, up from 14,821 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rfg Advisory Group Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $925.23B market cap company. The stock increased 1.04% or $1.93 during the last trading session, reaching $188.24. About 11.66 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Bowling Portfolio Management Llc, which manages about $492.89 million and $752.40 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Herman Miller Inc (NASDAQ:MLHR) by 12,249 shares to 53,864 shares, valued at $2.16M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Evertec Inc (NYSE:EVTC) by 44,246 shares in the quarter, for a total of 122,474 shares, and has risen its stake in Cousins Properties Inc (NYSE:CUZ).
